_note: Universal Flow image system (owner 2026-11-01: the one fixed system for every Adhyay). Series data only: characters, places, props (story-critical objects with an accepted sheet), style and wording rules. A new Adhyay adds characters/places HERE; scripts/flow/build_jobs_v2.py, neighbour_sheet.py and review_shot.py read it. Sentences are the strict accepted-sheet descriptions from the Adhyay 1 lessons (CODEX_IMAGE_LESSONS.md). 'sheet' paths are relative to D:/aai work/flow_outputs/adhyay_<NN>/references/ of the Adhyay that made the sheet ('sheet_adhyay').

model.name: Nano Banana 2.1
model._note: Owner 2026-11-01 (latest): Nano Banana 2.1 ONLY (not Pro), no fallback; always x2; both images reviewed by Haiku and Codex, Haiku decides.

style.text: Flat-colour 2D Indian devotional storybook illustration: clean dark navy-ink contour lines of steady medium weight, flat colour fills with a few fine hatch lines, warm earth palette, a FULL richly drawn frame with foreground, midground and background filled in.

tail: Full-frame 16:9 landscape picture, edge to edge, no border, no inset. No text, no letters, no modern objects, no halo.

GM_v01.name: the young ascetic
GM_v01.sentence: the young ascetic (attached GM_v01): a slim ADULT youth with a narrow face and cropped short dark hair, exactly as in his character sheet, wearing an open frayed grey-white vest that hangs open at the front in two loose panels with the chest visible between them (NOT a closed sleeveless undershirt, NOT a tank top) and a short white cloth wrapped at the hips, legs uncovered from above the knee down; no shirt, no trousers, never a child

BA_v01.name: Bankatlal
BA_v01.sentence: Bankatlal (attached BA_v01): an adult man of about 35, slightly full build, small neat moustache, cream-white round turban, long sage-green coat tied at the side over a white dhoti, cream shoulder cloth, exactly as in his character sheet

DK_v01.name: Damodarpant
DK_v01.sentence: Damodarpant (attached DK_v01): an adult man of about 35, lean and slightly taller than Bankatlal, thin moustache, terracotta-red turban, plain white long-sleeved shirt with no collar and no pockets, white dhoti, off-white shoulder cloth, exactly as in his character sheet

DV_v01.name: Devidas
DV_v01.sentence: Devidas (attached DV_v01): a householder of about 45, shaved head with a small tuft at the crown, greying temples, small red tilak, shoulders uncovered, white dhoti, exactly as in his character sheet
